title: Keep each region's products, and each thread's buffer, apart

blocks.text: The outdoor-gear chain's nightly report says which products sold in which region. Several report threads share one `RegionReport`, and to save allocations each thread renders into a buffer it keeps between reports. The test data had a single region and the report looked right; the first real night, regional managers complained that their section listed products they don't stock, and one report came out with half of another report's lines in it.

Finish `skusByRegion` and `newScratch` in `src/main/java/practice/RegionReport.java`. Each region lists only its own SKUs, sorted and without repeats, and each rendering thread has a buffer that no other thread touches and that it reuses from one report to the next. About three lines in total.

origin.section: A Factory Supplier Must Return a New Object on Every Call

concepts: A supplier passed as a factory, as to Collectors.toCollection or ThreadLocal.withInitial, must return a new object per call; one that returns a shared object makes every group or thread share it.
